description:
The complete Beamline library and how to choose from it: a selection guide (screens and kits, data → control, screen craft, looks and install), then every screen and component with what it is for and what to use instead.
Call it before designing and read every part in order; each answer names the next. Choose by the person's workflow and data: a block when its job, data and actions fit, otherwise the parts it is composed from; the most specific element for every item.

part.description: Which part (1 = the guide, default). Each answer names the next.
